title: Foreign Transaction Fee Rates — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
The foreign transaction fee on a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card purchase is a percentage of the purchase amount. A purchase is foreign when it is processed outside the United States or in a foreign currency.

| Card tier | Foreign transaction fee (percent of the purchase amount) | Fee refunded in proportion when the merchant refunds the purchase |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 3.00 percent | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 3.00 percent | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 1.50 percent | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 1.00 percent | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.00 percent | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 0.00 percent | yes |

**Rate footnotes**

- The rate applies to the purchase amount of each foreign purchase.
- The last column records that, on every tier, the foreign transaction fee is refunded in proportion when the merchant refunds the purchase.
- On Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit and Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit the rate is 0.00 percent, so a foreign purchase on those tiers carries no fee amount.
